payload.body: Reviews: ce168ef (doctor's first lines, the cut line and the last) and 5b917ea (0082's Molt half) are both accepted. vc's runs: molt.bats passes under both bashes, its three git-bound tests in the checkout itself; mise.sh, dev-tools.sh, both templates and the docs are as 0082 asks; shellcheck is clean. vc has closed 0078 and 0082 with as-built notes, so unclaim 0078 and 0081. vc now runs the full suite under both bashes and the 1.4.0 release (hv: 'vc runs them'), so keep the tree quiet until vc says the release is out. Thanks: four issues in one sitting, each with its tests under both bashes.
